assertions.description: SVGPathElement exposes getPathData() as a method (SVGPathData mixin).
SVGPathElement exposes setPathData() as a method (SVGPathData mixin).
SVGPathElement exposes getPathSegmentAtLength() as a method.
getPathData() returns plain {type, values} objects for each command as authored, keeping relative and shorthand letters.
assertions.test: (()=>{const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';const p=document.createElementNS(NS,'path');if(typeof p.getPathData!=='function')return false;p.setAttribute('d','M 10 20 h 30 q 5 5 10 0 Z');const s=p.getPathData();return s.length===4&&s[0].type==='M'&&s[0].values.join()==='10,20'&&s[1].type==='h'&&s[1].values.join()==='30'&&s[2].type==='q'&&s[2].values.join()==='5,5,10,0'&&s[3].type==='Z'&&s[3].values.length===0;})()

assertions.description: getPathData({normalize: true}) converts relative, H/V, quadratic and arc commands to absolute M, L, C and Z only.
assertions.test: (()=>{const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';const p=document.createElementNS(NS,'path');if(typeof p.getPathData!=='function')return false;p.setAttribute('d','M 10 10 h 20 v 20 q 10 10 20 0 a 10 10 0 0 1 20 0 z');const n=p.getPathData({normalize:true});return n.length>=6&&n.every(s=>/^[MLCZ]$/.test(s.type))&&n[1].type==='L'&&n[1].values.join()==='30,10'&&n[2].values.join()==='30,30';})()

assertions.description: setPathData() accepts plain object literals and sets the d attribute so getPathData() round-trips them.
getPathData() on a path with no valid path data returns an empty sequence.
getPathData() reflects the d attribute's base value, not a CSS d: path() override.
assertions.test: (()=>{const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';const svg=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg');const p=document.createElementNS(NS,'path');svg.appendChild(p);document.body.appendChild(svg);if(typeof p.getPathData!=='function'){svg.remove();return false;}p.setAttribute('d','M 1 2 L 3 4');p.style.d='path("M 50 50 L 60 60 L 70 50 Z")';const s=p.getPathData();svg.remove();return s.length===2&&s[1].values.join()==='3,4';})()

assertions.description: setPathData() throws a TypeError when a segment lacks the required values member.
assertions.test: (()=>{const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';const p=document.createElementNS(NS,'path');if(typeof p.setPathData!=='function')return false;try{p.setPathData([{type:'M'}]);return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError;}})()

assertions.description: getPathSegmentAtLength() clamps a negative distance to the first segment, clamps an over-long distance to the last, and returns null for an empty path.
assertions.test: (()=>{const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';const svg=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg');const p=document.createElementNS(NS,'path');const e=document.createElementNS(NS,'path');svg.append(p,e);document.body.appendChild(svg);if(typeof p.getPathSegmentAtLength!=='function'){svg.remove();return false;}p.setAttribute('d','M 0 0 L 10 0 L 10 10');const a=p.getPathSegmentAtLength(-5);const b=p.getPathSegmentAtLength(1000);const c=p.getPathSegmentAtLength(5);const n=e.getPathSegmentAtLength(1);svg.remove();return a&&a.type==='M'&&b&&b.type==='L'&&b.values.join()==='10,10'&&c&&c.type==='L'&&c.values.join()==='10,0'&&n===null;})()
